body.zh-Hant: 德意志傳記網站轉載的GND人名規範檔，記載維多利亞諾·韋爾塔的生卒年為1845年至1916年。《拉丁美洲歷史與文化百科》中費利佩·阿維拉撰寫的條目則寫，他本名何塞·維多利亞諾·韋爾塔·馬爾克斯，生於1854年3月23日，出生地是哈利斯科州的科洛特蘭，並說他在軍事學院的表現優異。兩份來源的出生年不同，本檔暫不取捨，另記為缺口。
body.en: The GND authority record shown on Deutsche Biographie gives Victoriano Huerta's life dates as 1845 to 1916. The entry by Felipe Avila in the Encyclopedia of Latin American History and Culture says that José Victoriano Huerta Márquez was born on 23 March 1854 in Colotlán, Jalisco, and had a brilliant career in the military academy. The two sources disagree on the birth year, so this file does not choose between them and records a gap.

citations.quote: Lebensdaten 1845 – 1916
José Victoriano Huerta Márquez was born March 23, 1854, in Colotlán, Jalisco
had a brilliant career in the military academy

heading.zh-Hant: 鎮壓叛亂與雷耶斯關係
heading.en: Campaigns against rebels and the Reyes connection

body.zh-Hant: 阿維拉的條目說，韋爾塔因1893年在格雷羅州鎮壓卡努托·內里領導的叛亂，以及1901至1902年對付尤卡坦與金塔納羅奧的馬雅人叛亂而獲得認可與晉升。1905年他是迪亞斯麾下最有威望軍官貝爾納多·雷耶斯的親近夥伴，雷耶斯失勢後他仍留在軍中，但聲勢低了許多。馬德羅上台後，下令他出兵對付三場最大的反馬德羅叛亂：北方帕斯誇爾·奧羅斯科的叛亂，他大勝；莫雷洛斯的埃米利亞諾·薩帕塔，他未能擊敗；最後則是雷耶斯與費利克斯·迪亞斯在墨西哥城的叛亂。
body.en: Avila's entry says Huerta won recognition and promotion by putting down the rebellion led by Canuto Neri in Guerrero in 1893 and the Maya rebellion in Yucatán and Quintana Roo in 1901–1902. In 1905 he was a close associate of Bernardo Reyes, the most prestigious officer of Porfirio Díaz's army, and after Reyes fell he kept serving at a much lower profile. After Madero took power he ordered Huerta to lead campaigns against the three largest anti-Madero rebellions: Pascual Orozco's in the north, where Huerta won a distinguished victory; Emiliano Zapata's in Morelos, whom he could not vanquish; and the one led by Reyes and Félix Díaz in Mexico City.

heading.en: The coup, the presidency and his fall

body.zh-Hant: 阿維拉寫道，韋爾塔在1913年2月推翻了馬德羅，成為共和國總統。他先背叛馬德羅，再用法律手段排除費利克斯·迪亞斯：依墨西哥法律，總統缺位時由外交部長接任，韋爾塔迫使國會任命他，馬德羅辭職、接任者佩德羅·拉斯庫賴因就任當天也辭職後，韋爾塔便依法成為總統；馬德羅與副總統皮諾·蘇亞雷斯隨後遇害。政府日益孤立，韋爾塔解散國會、行使獨裁權力，仍擋不住革命，1914年7月15日下台並離開墨西哥。
body.en: Avila writes that Huerta became president of the Republic after heading the coup that overthrew Francisco Madero in February 1913. He betrayed Madero and then got rid of Félix Díaz by a legal ploy: under Mexican law the foreign minister took over in the president's absence, Huerta forced Congress to appoint him, and when Madero resigned and his substitute Pedro Lascuráin resigned the same day he took office, Huerta became president legally; Madero and Vice-President Pino Suárez were then assassinated. The government grew isolated; Huerta dissolved Congress and wielded dictatorial powers that could not contain the revolution, and he stepped down on 15 July 1914 and left the country.

heading.zh-Hant: 流亡西班牙、美國與逝世
heading.en: Exile in Spain, the United States and death

body.zh-Hant: UNAM學者拉米雷斯·蘭卡尼奧的專書寫道，1914年9月下半月，韋爾塔只帶著家人前往巴塞隆納。阿維拉的條目則說，他於1915年3月進入美國並涉入反革命活動，遭美國當局逮捕、關在布利斯堡；因病曾在1915年11月獲釋兩週，12月中旬又被收押，1916年1月13日因肝硬化死於德州艾爾帕索的住處。
body.en: Mario Ramírez Rancaño's UNAM monograph says that in the second half of September 1914 Huerta went to Barcelona accompanied only by his family. Avila's entry says that in March 1915 he entered the United States and became involved in counterrevolutionary activities; US authorities arrested him and held him at Fort Bliss, freed him for two weeks in November 1915 because of illness, returned him to jail by mid-December, and he died of cirrhosis at his home in El Paso, Texas, on 13 January 1916.

body.zh-Hant: 德國GND人名規範檔（經lobid.org取得）記載，帕納伊斯·察爾達里斯生於1868年，卒於1936年5月17日；職業標為政治家與政府首腦，出生地為科林西亞地區，逝世地為雅典。希臘國會基金會介紹其傳記時，書名則標為1867至1936年，兩處的出生年相差一年，本檔不取捨，另記為缺口。
body.en: The German GND authority record, read through lobid.org, gives Panagis Tsaldaris's birth as 1868 and his death as 17 May 1936, lists him as politician and head of government, and places his birth in the Corinthia region and his death in Athens. The Hellenic Parliament Foundation titles the biography it reprinted as covering 1867 to 1936, so the two sources differ by one year on the birth year; this file does not choose and records a gap.

heading.zh-Hant: 人民黨領袖與和解主張
heading.en: People's Party leader and the policy of conciliation

body.zh-Hant: 希臘國會基金會在2014年的介紹中稱，察爾達里斯作為人民黨領袖與希臘總理，把協商和解的政策與超越民族分裂的主張連在一起；這番努力撞上了分裂之後整體的時代氣氛。該文又說，他政治溫和的價值在去世後才被看重。基金會重印的是記者喬治·武羅斯1955年出版的同名傳記，書中保存了他生平與政治活動的寶貴資料，並新增副教授康斯坦蒂娜·博齊烏撰寫的長篇導言。
body.en: In a 2014 notice the Hellenic Parliament Foundation says that, as leader of the People's Party and prime minister of Greece, Tsaldaris tied a policy of conciliation to the proposal to overcome the National Schism, and that this effort ran up against the general climate of the post-Schism era. It adds that the value of his political moderation was appreciated only after his death. The foundation reprinted the biography published in 1955 by the journalist Georgios Vouros, which preserves valuable information on his life and career, and added a long introduction by Konstantina Botsiou.

body.zh-Hant: 迪米特里斯·薩基斯2003年發表於大學期刊的論文說，1929年初，代表希臘兩大政治意識形態潮流的兩派首領韋尼澤洛斯與察爾達里斯，就1922年革命中處決「六人」的領導人是否保有完整政治權利互相通信。文中稱察爾達里斯為人民黨主席，並指出他本人並未直接參與「六人審判」。論文引述的信件有韋尼澤洛斯1929年1月31日寫給人民黨主席察爾達里斯的第一封信；總理韋尼澤洛斯在最後一封信裡，又呼籲反對派領袖讓人民黨回到議會與參議院。
body.en: A 2003 university-journal article by Dimitris Sakkis says that in early 1929 Venizelos and Tsaldaris, heads of the two factions representing Greece's two main political-ideological currents, corresponded about whether the leaders of the 1922 Revolution who carried out the execution of the Six kept their full political rights. It calls Tsaldaris president of the People's Party and says he had no direct involvement in the Trial of the Six. Among the letters it discusses is Venizelos's of 31 January 1929 to the People's Party president, Tsaldaris; in his last letter the prime minister, Venizelos, appeals to the leader of the opposition to bring the People's Party back to its place in Parliament and Senate.

heading.en: Life dates, education and first seat

body.zh-Hant: GND人名規範檔（經lobid.org取得）記載，何塞·卡納萊哈斯生於1854年7月31日的費羅爾，卒於1912年11月12日的馬德里，職業標為政治家與政府首腦。西班牙眾議院的傳略說他是法學與哲學文學的學士，1872年取得博士學位。BOE出版的導論則說，他於1882年代表自由黨首度當選議員，選區是索里亞省。
body.en: The GND authority record, read through lobid.org, gives José Canalejas's birth as 31 July 1854 in Ferrol and his death as 12 November 1912 in Madrid, and lists him as politician and head of government. The Congress of Deputies biography says he was a graduate in law and in philosophy and letters who took his doctorate in 1872. The BOE-published introduction says that in 1882 he won his first seat in Congress for the Liberal Party, for the province of Soria.

Date of death: 1912-11-12

Occupation: Politiker, Regierungschef

body.zh-Hant: 西班牙眾議院的傳略寫道，卡納萊哈斯1883年在波薩達·埃雷拉政府任總統府次官，1888年任公共工程部與司法部部長，1894年任財政部長，1902年在薩加斯塔政府任農工商部長。BOE導論則寫他在薩加斯塔政府中是1892年出任財政部長，與眾議院所記的年份不同，本檔另記為缺口。他此後在眾議院又連任議員，1893年起多次代表阿利坎特選區。以上職務都落在1908年之前。
body.en: The Congress of Deputies biography says Canalejas was undersecretary of the Presidency under Posada Herrera in 1883, minister of Fomento and of Gracia y Justicia in 1888 and of Hacienda in 1894, and in 1902 headed the Ministry of Agriculture, Industry and Commerce under Sagasta. The BOE introduction instead places his Hacienda portfolio under Sagasta in 1892, a year that differs from the Congress page, so a gap is recorded. He was afterwards returned repeatedly to the Congress, from 1893 for Alicante. All these posts fall before 1908.

citations.quote: como subsecretario de Presidencia, con Posada Herrera, en 1883
fue ministro de Fomento y de Gracia y Justicia en 1888, y de Hacienda en 1894
En 1902 ocupó el Ministerio de Agricultura, Industria y Comercio
bajo el Gobierno de Sagasta
Con Sagasta en el gobierno de 1892 ocupó la cartera de Hacienda

heading.en: President of the Congress of Deputies

body.zh-Hant: 西班牙眾議院的傳略記載，卡納萊哈斯在1905至1907年的屆期內，於1906年1月19日至1907年1月24日擔任眾議院議長。他以262票中的261票獲選，另有一張空白票。這項職務在1908至1945年的範圍之外。
body.en: The Congress of Deputies biography records that, in the 1905–1907 legislature, Canalejas was president of the Chamber from 19 January 1906 to 24 January 1907. He was chosen by 261 of the 262 votes cast, with one blank ballot. This post lies outside the 1908–1945 window.

citations.quote: entre el 19 de enero de 1906 y el 24 de enero de 1907
Fue nombrado Presidente por 261 votos, del total de 262; una papeleta en blanco.

body.zh-Hant: 西班牙眾議院的傳略說，卡納萊哈斯1910年2月出任部長會議主席。BOE導論寫他1910年登上政府首腦之位，在兩年的任內從未得到自家議會黨團毫無裂縫的支持；1910年12月28日《馬德里公報》刊出了所謂「掛鎖法」。他在1912年10月強硬鎮壓鐵路總罷工。1912年11月12日，他在太陽門的聖馬丁書店櫥窗前被一名無政府主義者開槍殺害。
body.en: The Congress of Deputies biography says Canalejas became president of the Council of Ministers in February 1910. The BOE introduction says that after reaching the head of government in 1910, in his two years in office he never had the unbroken support of his parliamentary group, and that the so-called Ley del Candado appeared in the Gaceta of 28 December 1910. He harshly suppressed the general railway strike of October 1912. On 12 November 1912 he was shot dead by an anarchist while stopping at the window of the San Martín bookshop on the Puerta del Sol.
